extension.summary: Tailscale 1.104.5 for CoreELEC 22 ARM64 with Kodi 22 settings support
Tailscale 1.104.5 voor CoreELEC 22 ARM64 met ondersteuning voor Kodi 22-instellingen
extension.description: CoreELEC 22/Piers ARM64 only. Keeps the official addon ID, settings and tailnet state. Supports settings XML formats 1-4 and defaults to retaining CoreELEC DNS. Select this repository for updates to retain the fork fixes.
extension.news: 22.0.13.100: Updates the bundled official Tailscale ARM64 binaries to stable version 1.104.5. Retains settings XML version 4 support, optional Tailscale DNS disabled by default, persistent daemon state, and existing login and configuration.
